title: Creative Technologist
description:

We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 20 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.

Headquartered In Mountain View, We Are a Team Of 100 Passionate And Experienced AI Enthusiasts And Video Experts, Driven By Our Core Values
Be a Champion Team
Prioritize Ruthlessly
Ship fast, Quality Follows
Obsess over customers
Be a part of this exciting journey with us!
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a Creative Technologist to help define the next generation of AI-powered video creation at OpusClip. You'll work at the intersection of visual design, generative AI, storytelling, and workflow innovation—elevating AI-generated content from impressive to exceptional.
You have exceptional creative taste and a deep understanding of generative AI. You don't just generate assets—you refine, direct, and elevate them until every frame meets your standards.
You are naturally curious, constantly exploring new tools and techniques, and you enjoy building systems that turn creative intuition into scalable workflows.
Responsibilities
Partner closely with the AI team to improve the quality, consistency, and creative direction of AI-generated video content.
Develop prompting frameworks and generation workflows that consistently produce high-quality outputs at scale.
Create repeatable creative systems that capture and operationalize visual taste, design principles, and storytelling best practices.
Evaluate and refine AI-generated assets, identifying and correcting issues related to composition, motion, continuity, realism, and visual quality.
Experiment with emerging AI creative tools and technologies, translating new capabilities into compelling product and content experiences.
Collaborate across product, design, marketing, and AI teams to help shape the future of AI video creation.
Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with generative AI tools for image, video, or creative content generation.
Excellent visual design, motion design, or creative direction instincts with a high standard for quality and detail.
Deep understanding of prompt engineering, creative workflows, and AI generation techniques.
Strong storytelling instincts with an understanding of pacing, narrative structure, and visual communication.
Ability to create scalable frameworks and processes rather than relying solely on one-off creative execution.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with rapidly evolving tools and workflows.
What Makes You Successful
You can quickly spot visual inconsistencies, quality issues, and creative opportunities that others miss.
You understand both the capabilities and limitations of today's AI models and know how to consistently push them further.
You naturally think in systems, workflows, and reusable frameworks that help teams scale creative output.
You combine artistic judgment with technical curiosity, constantly testing new tools and approaches.
You care deeply about the final product and are willing to iterate until the work reaches a high creative standard.
Nice to Have
Background in product design, visual design, motion graphics, creative technology, or related fields.
Experience building node-based workflows in ComfyUI, Fal, or similar AI infrastructure tools.
Previous experience in video production, film, advertising, gaming, or other creative industries.
The Details
Location: On-site in Mountain View, CA
Competitive salary, equity, and performance-based bonuses
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Opportunity to help shape one of the fastest-moving categories in AI
You Should Not Apply If
You rarely review or critique your own AI-generated work for quality and consistency.
You view prompting as the entire job rather than one part of a larger creative process.
You prefer receiving fully defined briefs instead of building new systems and workflows from scratch.
You are not genuinely excited about the future of AI-generated video and creative tooling.

About The Role
OpusClip is looking for a staff-level, product-oriented Data Science Lead to lead a team of approximately five: two Data Scientists, two analysts, and one to two Data Engineers. Title will be calibrated to experience.
This is a hands-on role: you will set the Data roadmap, personally tackle our hardest analytical problems, and build an increasingly AI-native data function. You can lead through technical direction or direct management; formal people management is not required.
You will work closely with Product, Growth, Finance, Engineering, and AI to turn trusted data into better product and business decisions.
Success means delivering measurable business improvements while building the systems and practices that let a small Data team support a growing company.
What You’ll Do
Lead the team and strengthen the data foundation
Set priorities, develop the team through technical direction and example, and focus capacity on the highest-impact problems. Personally lead ambiguous, high-stakes analyses.
Own standards for metric definitions, data validation, and analytical quality. Partner with Engineering to diagnose and prevent recurring issues across tracking, pipelines, transformations, and dashboards.
Turn recurring requests into reusable datasets, frameworks, and self-service tools so teams can make sound decisions with less manual support.
Drive product and growth decisions
Use behavioral analysis, user profiling, and segmentation to identify opportunities across activation, retention, monetization, and lifetime value. Translate findings into recommendations that inform product strategy, operations, and company goals.
Strengthen experimentation and causal measurement across Product and Growth. Evaluate acquisition quality and the long-term value of different channels and customer segments, moving beyond attribution toward incrementality to guide investment and improve CAC.
Connect product data to AI improvement
Partner with AI teams on data curation, evaluation design, and online and offline measurement. Turn product behavior into useful evaluation data, feedback signals, and failure cases.
Connect changes in AI quality to user behavior and business outcomes, creating a measurable loop from product usage to AI improvement and better product experiences.
Build AI-native analytics
Use AI to automate recurring analysis and explore agentic systems that detect unusual metric movements, identify contributing segments, and investigate likely causes.
Make these workflows reliable enough for teams to use, moving from one-off requests toward proactive insights with clear validation and human judgment.
What We’re Looking For
Significant experience in data science, product analytics, decision science, or a related field, with demonstrated Staff, Principal, Lead, or equivalent scope, regardless of title.
Strong product and business judgment: you identify important questions, navigate ambiguity, and turn evidence into decisions.
Strong SQL and Python skills and a willingness to stay hands-on.
Deep experience with product metrics and user behavior, plus a strong foundation in statistics, A/B testing, and causal reasoning.
Strong data-quality instincts and enough engineering knowledge to trace data through a system, diagnose recurring pipeline problems, and work effectively with engineers on durable fixes.
Ability to lead through influence, technical credibility, and clear communication across technical and business teams.
Deep data infrastructure expertise and model-training experience are not required.
Nice to Have
Experience measuring paid marketing incrementality and acquisition economics.
Experience partnering with AI/ML teams on evaluation or data curation, or building AI-assisted or agentic analytics systems.
Experience in SaaS, consumer software, creator products, subscription businesses, or AI products.
What Success Looks Like
Within Your First 6–12 Months, You Will Have
Delivered measurable business impact: led 1–2 high-impact projects where Data contributes roughly 8%+ improvement to a key metric such as retention, conversion, CAC, monetization, or product adoption.
Built a more effective Data function: improved metric quality, experimentation, and validation while raising the team's focus and analytical standards.
Made the team's work go further: shipped reusable tools that help Product, Growth, or AI teams achieve better outcomes without repeated one-off analysis.
Established a measurable AI feedback loop: turned product behavior into better evaluation data and demonstrable product improvements.
Beyond These Initial Milestones
Expand your influence and scope: shape company strategy by uncovering major growth opportunities, with room to take on broader Data leadership as the team and business scale.
Why Join Us
Shape how Data works. Define the team's priorities and operating model, with direct influence on product direction, growth investment, monetization, and AI quality.
Stay close to the work. Combine senior technical leadership with difficult analytical problems and practical AI systems.
Build on a modern stack. Work with BigQuery, Mixpanel, Superset, Python, Prefect, and Statsig.

About The Role
OpusClip is the world's #1 AI video agent for social media, used by 20M+ creators and businesses to turn raw footage into viral-ready clips. We're hiring an AI Product Manager , based in Mountain View , to own the core product roadmap that shapes how millions of creators experience OpusClip every day. Your job is to keep raising the bar on what our product can do and how good it feels, at the pace of a team that ships constantly.
This role sits at the AI end of that roadmap. You'll own the features where model capability is the product, which means going deeper than most PMs do on what the models can actually deliver and on how we measure whether the output is any good.
You'll work out of our headquarters, in the same market as most of our creators and business customers. The people you build for are a coffee away rather than a time zone away, and we expect you to use that.
What You'll Do
Own a Direction, Not a Backlog: Set the strategy for your surface, commit to the metrics it should move, and be the one accountable when they don't move.
Own the AI Quality Loop: Define what "good output" means for a generative feature, build the evaluation that measures it, and use that eval to decide what ships and what doesn't. On an AI product, taste alone isn't enough and a benchmark alone isn't either.
Be the Taste and Quality Bar: Act as the filter for what "good" looks like on a product used by millions. Every feature should feel considered, polished, and worth the user's trust.
Ship at Scale and Breadth: Run multiple feature workstreams in parallel without losing depth or craft. Know when to go deep on one feature and when to parallelize across several.
Codify a Repeatable Playbook: Turn your instincts into a method for how to scope, validate, and ship AI-powered features fast, and use it to raise the bar for the broader PM team, not just your own roadmap.
Partner Deeply with Engineering and Design: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with a high-caliber team to translate frontier AI capabilities (multimodal models, agents) into features creators reach for daily.
Go Deep with Users: Use direct research, data, and hands-on product use to find the gap between what the product does today and what creators actually need next.
What We're Looking For
5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning and shipping complex, high-usage features on a consumer or prosumer product
Deep, hands-on fluency with AI. You judge a model's real capability from your own testing rather than from its benchmark scores, and you can tell a model problem from a prompt problem from a product problem.
Comfort with evaluation. You've had to decide whether a generative output is good enough to ship when there was no obvious metric, and you built something repeatable to answer it rather than relying on vibes.
Goal-oriented and ruthless about priority. You work backward from the outcome you own, not the backlog. You can say why the top three things on your roadmap are the top three, and why everything else waits.
Ownership by default. You chase the loose ends nobody assigned to you, and you close the loop yourself: ship it, read the data, decide to iterate or kill it.
Defensible taste. You can name what is wrong with the products you admire most, not only what is good about them.
Experience building consumer-facing (B2C) products and a habit of direct user research
Based in the Bay Area and able to work on-site in Mountain View; comfortable partnering daily with our Shanghai and Vancouver teams across time zones
Bonus If You Have
Built evals for a generative feature, or worked with fine-tuned or post-trained models in production
Background taking a product from early PMF to a mature, high-scale stage
Experience with short-form video, content creation, or creator tools
Direct experience shipping AI/LLM-powered features
Ability to prototype using code or no-code tools
This Role Probably Isn't Right For You If…
You're energized by 0-to-1 ambiguity but lose interest once a product has real scale and real constraints
Your experience with AI is mostly reading about it. This role needs someone who has put their hands on the models.
You'd rather define strategy from a slide than get hands-on with the craft of a specific feature
You need a large team or established process to feel effective. This role expects you to build the playbook, not just follow one.
You haven't used a video editing or content creation tool yourself in the past year
You're uncomfortable operating with ambiguity and rapid iteration
You want remote or hybrid

Scale outreach. Build and run high-volume outreach systems (sourcing, sequencing, follow-ups, and automation) to grow our creator pipeline every week.
Negotiate and close. Run negotiations with creators, managers, and agencies across many deals at once. Land fair rates, clear deliverables, and the usage rights we need, within budget.
Launch campaigns end to end. Own briefs, contracts, content review, posting schedules, and payments so every partnership ships on time.
Build lasting creator relationships. Turn one-off sponsorships into long-term partnerships. Be the person creators trust and want to work with again.
Know the landscape. Track creator economy trends, platform changes, and rate benchmarks. Use what you learn to sharpen who we partner with and how.
Measure and optimize. Report on views, CPM, signups, and ROI for every campaign. Double down on what works and cut what doesn't.
Own the pipeline. Keep our creator CRM and deal tracker accurate, current, and easy for the team to use.
Show up at events. Join and support the team at industry events, meet creators in person, and turn those conversations into partnerships.
Bring the creator voice inside. Share creator feedback and content insights with product and marketing.
📝 Qualifications
4+ years of hands-on experience in influencer marketing or creator partnerships, ideally at a tech or SaaS company.
A proven record of running high-volume creator programs: dozens of live partnerships at a time, managed across a full pipeline.
Strong negotiation skills, with direct experience contracting creators, talent managers, and agencies.
Deep knowledge of the creator economy across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and X, including formats, audiences, and rate benchmarks.
A bias for action. You move fast, follow up relentlessly, and ship campaigns while others are still planning.
Highly organized, with the systems to track hundreds of conversations without dropping one.
A data-driven approach to measuring campaign performance and making budget decisions.
A natural relationship builder. Creators enjoy working with you and come back for more.
Comfortable in a fast-paced startup where priorities shift quickly.
Passionate about AI and video.
📝 Bonus Points
You've run influencer marketing for a company that sells to marketers, SMBs, or agencies.
You already have a strong network of creators, talent managers, and agencies.
You've built outreach automation with tools like Clay, Instantly, or similar.
You have experience managing communications at scale, able to manage hundreds of relationships simultaneously.
You're a creator yourself, or you've worked closely on short-form video.
You've grown an affiliate or ambassador program.

You're looking for a sales, business development, or event planning role.
